harness.note: plan interpreter written after this plan; it pins this plan's sha256 and the checker sha256 and executes exactly the hashed checker bytes

semantics.match: a control MATCHES iff every key in `expect` equals the corresponding key of the observed outcome; extra observed keys are recorded, not compared
semantics.hand_derived: every expectation is derived by hand from the written rules (see `why`) EXCEPT C01, DR1, DP1 whose VERIFIED/clean expectation is inherited from the accepted parent replay (they are positive real-data controls, not independent evidence)
semantics.real_data_positive: the main replay itself (expected PASS with 1,575,031 leaves, 61,124 verified, rule counts K 55159 RLP 5513 FH5 134 N26 108 PB 55 RPLP 155) is the full positive control and is NOT part of this harness
semantics.mutations_in_memory: all mutated inputs live in memory; pinned files are never written; pipeline controls with repin pass pins of the mutated bytes through the in-process API only (the CLI has no pin override)
semantics.intended_reason: a mutation control MATCHES only if the checker rejects with the named reason code (stage + code), so an incidental rejection (e.g. a hash pin) does not count
